patches.value: Expand y^(λ+1)v in the complex basis using T001 and T003; distinct complex weights force it and all higher lowering powers to vanish. Normalize the positive-exponent raising/lowering identities by factorials. For the separate zero-exponent endpoint, ev y v 0=v by definition and H004 supplies x v=0, giving x e₀=0; T001's raising identity is guarded by 0<t and is not used at t=0. Thus every case of genFormulas has an explicit allowed input. This restores the existing highest-vector base condition at the T004 worker boundary; no premise, definition, target or source proof is changed.
